page_title: BRA 1-1 MOR | Brazil v Morocco 13/06/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+10' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.

90+9' Alisson dives superbly and makes a brilliant save to deny a first-time long-range effort towards the bottom right corner. Neil El Aynaoui (Morocco) was the player who tested the keeper's reflexes. Nice goalkeeping skills. Alisson pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Ayoube Amaimouni (Morocco) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the bottom right corner. The referee blows his whistle, Morocco are awarded a corner kick.

90+7' Samir El Mourabet (Morocco) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
90+7' Fabinho (Brazil) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Slavko Vincic blows for a foul. Morocco have a free kick.
90+5' Samir El Mourabet (Morocco) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

90+5' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Soufiane Rahimi was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat. The referee points to the corner flag and Morocco will take a corner.
90+3' A pass into the box finds Danilo Santos (Brazil) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Bono denies him.
90+3' Matheus Cunha (Brazil) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
90+3' Matheus Cunha (Brazil) sends the corner into the box, but Bono intercepts it and averts the threat.
90+2' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Brazil are awarded a corner kick.
90+1' Raphinha (Brazil) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
90' We will have 10 min. of added time.

90' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Slavko Vincic stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. It's a free kick to Morocco, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
89' Here comes a substitution. Ismael Saibari is given a rest as he is replaced by Soufiane Rahimi (Morocco).
88' Ayoube Amaimouni (Morocco) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
87' Corner kicks – 4:0. 14:12 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
86' Bono (Morocco) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
84' Bono (Morocco) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
80' Substitution. Bruno Guimaraes is replaced by Danilo Santos (Brazil).
80' Here is a change. Bilal El Khannouss is going off and Mohamed Ouahbi gives the last tactical orders to Ayoube Amaimouni (Morocco).
80' Here comes a substitution. Anass Salah-Eddine (Morocco) is brought on as a substitute for Noussair Mazraoui.
79' The game is interrupted now, Bono (Morocco) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
78' Raphinha (Brazil) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Bono blocks the shot with his legs.
77' Chemsdine Talbi (Morocco) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
76' The attendance is 80663.
75' Noussair Mazraoui (Morocco) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
73' Total attempts – 9:12. 3:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
72' Ismael Saibari (Morocco) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
68' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
67' Bruno Guimaraes (Brazil) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Raphinha.
67' Raphinha (Brazil) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
65' It is time for a substitution. Samir El Mourabet (Morocco) is on for Azzedine Ounahi.
65' Mohamed Ouahbi prepares a substitution. Brahim Diaz is replaced by Chemsdine Talbi (Morocco).
63' Ismael Saibari (Morocco) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Brazil will take a free kick.
62' Igor Thiago goes off the pitch and Luiz Henrique (Brazil) comes on.
61' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to make a change. Matheus Cunha (Brazil) replaces Lucas Paqueta.
60' A pass by Vinicius Junior (Brazil) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
57' Igor Thiago (Brazil) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
55' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Neil El Aynaoui (Morocco) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
54' Good defending. Bruno Guimaraes (Brazil) tries to find Vinicius Junior inside the box, but the pass is cut out.

53' Raphinha (Brazil) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.

52' Bono pulls off a great save to deny Igor Thiago (Brazil) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the underside of the crossbar, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
52' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) takes a quick throw-in so that his teammates can outnumber the defenders in the penalty box.
52' Danilo (Brazil) tries to find Raphinha, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball goes out of play and Morocco will have a goal kick.

51' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
51' Morocco control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
48' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Raphinha (Brazil) sends it out of play.
48' Raphinha (Brazil) takes the corner which is cleared. The ball goes out of play. Brazil are awarded a corner kick.
47' Raphinha (Brazil) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. It will be a corner kick for Brazil.
46' The game is over for Casemiro (Brazil). Fabinho comes on for the second half.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Carlo Ancelotti probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Ibanez (Brazil). He is replaced by Danilo.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Raphinha sends the ball into the centre of the box from the corner. Marquinhos (Brazil) bursts through a crowd of players but heads the ball miles wide of the left post.
45+3' Raphinha (Brazil) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

45+2' It's unbelievable, Lucas Paqueta (Brazil) blows a huge opportunity! He is totally unmarked and fires a first-time shot towards the right post from a few yards out, but Bono reacts superbly to keep the ball out. Brazil will take a corner kick.
45+1' Bruno Guimaraes (Brazil) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Slavko Vincic blows his whistle after Bilal El Khannouss (Morocco) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. A free kick is awarded to Brazil.
43' This is a yellow card! Ibanez (Brazil) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
43' The ball is cleared after Bruno Guimaraes (Brazil) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
42' The foul by Neil El Aynaoui (Morocco) was seen by Slavko Vincic who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
41' Casemiro (Brazil) sends a long cross over to Raphinha, but Bono comes forward to gather the ball.
40' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) plays a one-two with Lucas Paqueta, but the move breaks down.
38' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.
37' Casemiro (Brazil) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
36' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 4:12. 1:2 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
35' Brahim Diaz (Morocco) serves up a nice cross, but Alisson punches the ball away.
35' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
34' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) brings his opponent down. Slavko Vincic has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Morocco have a free kick.

32' 1 - 1 Vinicius Junior (Brazil) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Bono is just a bystander as the ball flies into the top right corner. The score is 1:1.
31' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) pounces on a bouncing ball on the edge of the box, but sends his volley high over the bar.
30' Brahim Diaz (Morocco) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
30' Ismael Saibari (Morocco) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
29' Douglas Santos (Brazil) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Slavko Vincic signals. That's a free kick to Morocco.
27' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies well wide of the left post.
27' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) is penalised for a foul. Slavko Vincic had a clear view and blows his whistle.
23' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!

21' 0 - 1 What a goal that is! Ismael Saibari (Morocco) received the ball on the edge of the 18-yard box and spotted the goalkeeper off his line. He set himself up perfectly and lobbed the ball over Alisson and into the net. Brahim Diaz provided the assistance. 0:1.
20' Lucas Paqueta (Brazil) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
20' Bruno Guimaraes (Brazil) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

19' Raphinha (Brazil) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Vinicius Junior, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception. Now Brazil have a corner.
18' Half-chance! Raphinha (Brazil) plays a pass into the box, but Bono reacts well to snuff out the attack.
17' Brazil are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
16' The ratio of the ball possession is 46:54.
15' Lucas Paqueta (Brazil) sends a long ball in, but Bono comfortably gathers the ball.
14' Igor Thiago (Brazil) reacts well to meet the lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but sends a weak header well wide of the right post.
12' Noussair Mazraoui (Morocco) attempts to find Ismael Saibari with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
11' Some neat passing and movement from Morocco as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
10' Azzedine Ounahi (Morocco) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
9' Brahim Diaz (Morocco) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
9' Raphinha (Brazil) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.
7' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the left post.
6' What a great touch by Neil El Aynaoui (Morocco) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
6' Brahim Diaz (Morocco) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
4' The free kick is taken by Bilal El Khannouss (Morocco), but ball is cleared.
3' Ibanez (Brazil) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Morocco.
2' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
2' Douglas Santos (Brazil) makes a slide tackle, but referee Slavko Vincic blows for a foul.
1' The first half has started.
Morocco will kick-off.
